atoms.b: This diagram shows the inside of a volcano. ((++Magma Smoke)) is deep in the earth.
Magma is a very hot, melted natural material that comes to the surface through volcanoes. When magma reaches the earth’s surface, it turns into ((++lava magma)).
When a volcano erupts, a lot of ((smoke --wind)) comes out of the top.
